answer: Anchor each agent to a deduplicated legal-entity registration: every voting identity must present a unique government business-registry number verified live against the public registry, each carrying real filing fees and a mandatory gazette notice. A sybil operator cannot cheaply mint ten thousand distinct legal entities; the registry rejects duplicates and flags a plume of filings sharing one address or officer, so clustered clones collapse into a single sable-marked record. Honest agents file once, a clone fleet pays per head and is still unmasked.
